bullet_facts.fact: Dwight was thinking of proposing to Esther, mentioning her qualities and her family's admiration.
Jim told Dwight that love is the one thing that outweighs everything else when facing tough decisions.
Jim advised Dwight to forget about logic and fear and to follow his love for Angela.
Jim and Pam are dating, and they discussed their relationship openly.
Dwight betrayed Jim by forming an alliance and trying to get information from him, indicating a competitive relationship.
Dwight has expressed that he didn't see his father for the first two years of his life and thought his mother was his father.

supporting_quotes.quote:
Jim: I don't know what you want me to tell you, man. All I know is that every time I've been faced with a tough decision, there's only one thing that outweighs every other concern. One thing that will make you give up on everything you thought you knew, every instinct, every rational calculation.
Dwight: Some sort of virus?
Jim: Love.

Jim: Dwight, listen: no matter what happens, you gotta forget about all the other stuff. You gotta forget about logic and fear and doubt. You just gotta do everything you can to get to the one woman who's gonna make all this worth it. At the end of the day, you gotta jump. You love Angela, Dwight. I think you always have.

Jim (Pam and Jim watch video of their kiss on the tv): Oh, ah… No that's not… I mean that wasn't, ah…
Pam: Yeah… That was um…
Jim: I mean I can see how it would seem a bit like we uh… How it looks like um… I mean now a days you can edit anything, right? I mean you can edit anything to look like um… anything.
Pam: Yeah, I gave him a ride home because…
Jim: Right!
Pam: … We're dating.
Jim: Wow! There it is.
Pam: Ah, yeah. We haven't told anybody, but it's going really great. Right?
[STAGE] looks at Jim
Jim: It is going really great.
